name: create_hr_case_balance_dispute
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee discovers their available annual leave is zero due to an unrecorded carry-forward from last year and asks to open an HR dispute case.
tests: Checks balance and files an HR case with category balance_dispute for missing carried-forward leave.
instruction:
You believe you should have 5 days of annual leave carried forward from last year, but after checking your balance you see 0 available days. You want the assistant to open an official HR support case for a balance dispute so HR can audit and rectify your carryover allocation.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E07
- Name: George Clark
- Region: UK
- Issue: Missing 5 days annual leave carryover from 2025
- Case Category: balance_dispute
- Subject: Annual leave carry-forward balance dispute

persona.name: George Clark
persona.initial_message: Hello, my annual leave balance shows 0 available days, but I had 5 carried forward days from last year. Can you open an HR case for this?

arguments.subject: Annual leave carry-forward balance dispute
arguments.description: Employee disputes missing 5 days carry-forward from 2025
